findings.issue: Kana transcription contains きごう ('kigou', the reading of 記号 'symbol') twice — the tokenizer read the two spaces in the jp as the word 記号. Extra syllables make the phonetic reading wrong.
findings.current: おかあさんにきごうおかしをきごうもらいました
findings.suggested: おかあさんにおかしをもらいました

findings.issue: Romaji inherits the same defect: 'kigou' inserted twice for the space characters. This is not the known punctuation/katakana issue — it adds nonexistent syllables.
Token with surface ' ' (a space) is assigned reading きごう. A whitespace token has no reading; it should be removed or have r null.
findings.suggested: null (remove the space token or blank its reading)

findings.issue: Second space-surface token also assigned reading きごう. Same defect as tokens[4].
findings.suggested: null (remove the space token or blank its reading)

findings.issue: 紹介 glossed as 'presentation' — a false friend from pt 'apresentação'. In English 紹介 (introducing a person) is 'introduction', never 'presentation'.
Literal mirror renders subject-marker が as the topic device 'As for the sky', which the corpus reserves for は. It contradicts expl_en, which correctly says が marks the subject.
findings.current: As for the sky, when it clouds over, it becomes cold.
findings.suggested: The sky (subject) — when it clouds over, it becomes cold.

findings.issue: Same mirroring error in pt: 'Quanto ao céu' presents が as se fosse o tópico は; the corpus uses 'Quanto a...' only for は, and expl_pt correctly calls 空が sujeito.
findings.current: Quanto ao céu, se/quando fica nublado, fica frio (torna-se frio).
findings.suggested: O céu (sujeito), quando fica nublado, fica frio (torna-se frio).

findings.issue: Note calls まし the 'past form of ます'. Wrong grammar fact: まし is the conjunctive stem (連用形) of ます; the past is formed by adding た. Same file states it correctly elsewhere (sent:gen-37e250b9dabc).
findings.current: forma passada まし de ます / past form まし of ます
findings.suggested: raiz (連用形) まし de ます, antes de た / conjunctive stem まし of ます, before た

findings.issue: ます glossed as '(polite verbal copula)'. ます is a politeness auxiliary (助動詞), not a copula; calling it a copula teaches a false category (the same batch correctly labels です as copula).
Same defect in pt: ます rotulado como 'cópula polida verbal'; não é cópula, é auxiliar de polidez (the role field itself says 'auxiliar de polidez').
'são sujos' states an inherent quality; the sentence describes a current state (shoes are dirty now, hence washing). BR-PT requires 'estão sujos' — the natural pt translation already uses it.
findings.current: Como os sapatos são sujos, (eu) lavo.
findings.suggested: Como os sapatos estão sujos, (eu) lavo.

findings.issue: あたたかい glossed 'warm, lukewarm'. 'Lukewarm' (tepid, negatively not-hot) is ぬるい, not あたたかい, which means pleasantly warm; the pt gloss 'quente (agradável)' has it right.
Parenthetical gloss 'zero ponto' lacks number agreement; pt-BR uses plural after zero ('zero pontos'), matching expl_en 'zero points'.
findings.current: 零点 (zero ponto) é o objeto marcado por を
findings.suggested: 零点 (zero pontos) é o objeto marcado por を

findings.issue: 時計 glossed 'clock', but in this sentence (Swiss-made, translated 'This watch') the contextual sense is 'watch'; pt gloss 'relógio' covers both, the en gloss does not.
